chunked_prefill_small.completion_behavior: Completion-safe in audited pilots; completion is not the primary objective.
chunked_prefill_small.fairness_behavior: Implicit temporal sharing through chunking, not explicit class fairness.
known_failure_modes: underperforms full_prefill when uninterrupted prefill is beneficial
collapses to full/near-tie when prefill not active
chunked_prefill_small.kv_load_behavior: No explicit KV reserve, but chunking can reduce bursty prompt pressure.
chunked_prefill_small.latency_slo_behavior: Protects late/short tenant TTFT but can hurt hog TTFT.
chunked_prefill_small.overlap_with_other_policies: Complements full_prefill in Family B; ties all six on public trace ANWG.
chunked_prefill_small.prefill_decode_behavior: Prefill chunking is the central mechanism.
chunked_prefill_small.primary_scheduling_mechanism: Greedy arrival-order admission with small prefill chunks; slices prompt work to interleave classes.
strongest_workload_regimes: cases where crumbs prevent prompt convoying
weakest_workload_regimes: hog-prefill cases where chunking adds interchunk wait
public saturated-at-1.0 traces where chunking changes timing but not ANWG

estimated_service_time_first.fairness_behavior: No explicit class deficit; fairness can degrade.
known_failure_modes: fairness/SLO protection failure on high-skew favored-long Family A
selector/composite attempts around ESTF/WFS failed held-out support and mechanism gates
estimated_service_time_first.kv_load_behavior: KV-blind except through prompt in service proxy.
estimated_service_time_first.latency_slo_behavior: Improves short-job completion/latency but can starve long high-priority tenants.
estimated_service_time_first.overlap_with_other_policies: High reward correlation with WFS in Family A (0.9705) despite bidirectional wins.
estimated_service_time_first.prefill_decode_behavior: Uses token-length proxy but does not control chunk size.
estimated_service_time_first.primary_scheduling_mechanism: Shortest estimated service first using prompt and predicted output tokens.
strongest_workload_regimes: Family A favored-short or size-priority-aligned regimes
high-utilization cases where completion protection matters
weakest_workload_regimes: favored-long/high-skew regimes where WFS class protection matters

full_prefill.completion_behavior: Completes admitted work reliably in audited prefill/decode pilots; not a completion-prioritizing size rule.
full_prefill.fairness_behavior: No explicit fairness or class-debt protection.
known_failure_modes: convoying late tenants behind hog prompts
degenerate with chunked policy when prefill is not the bottleneck
full_prefill.kv_load_behavior: No explicit KV reserve beyond simulator feasibility.
full_prefill.latency_slo_behavior: Can lower hog/large-job TTFT but can increase late tenant prefill waiting under contention.
full_prefill.overlap_with_other_policies: Ties all policies on public trace ANWG; is the full-chunk anchor opposite chunked_prefill_small in Family B.
full_prefill.prefill_decode_behavior: Maximal prefill chunk; favors uninterrupted prompt processing.
full_prefill.primary_scheduling_mechanism: Greedy arrival-order admission with effectively unlimited prompt/prefill chunk; lets long prefills run without artificial chunking.
strongest_workload_regimes: Family B hog-prefill cases where uninterrupted prefill protects hog TTFT/E2E
public traces under frozen capacity, though all six tie on ANWG
weakest_workload_regimes: late-arriving short/urgent decode or TTFT-sensitive tenants behind long prefill
prefill/decode contention with crumb fairness needed

kv_constrained_online.completion_behavior: May trade bulk completion/throughput for reserve safety.
kv_constrained_online.fairness_behavior: No explicit class debt except urgent bypass.
known_failure_modes: over-conservative reserve under some arrival timing
KV composition/hysteresis child did not prove safe envelope expansion
kv_constrained_online.kv_load_behavior: Strongest explicit KV/load mechanism among the six.
kv_constrained_online.latency_slo_behavior: Protects urgent work by preventing bulk KV saturation; may defer bulk work.
kv_constrained_online.overlap_with_other_policies: Dominant Family C best fixed; limited marginal headroom but unique mechanism.
kv_constrained_online.prefill_decode_behavior: No chunk-size controller, but admission affects prompt/KV load.
kv_constrained_online.primary_scheduling_mechanism: KV-aware online admission preserving a target KV reserve, with urgent-laxity bypass.
strongest_workload_regimes: Family C bulk pressure and scarce-KV regimes
urgent tenants arriving under high reserve pressure
weakest_workload_regimes: low KV pressure where reserve deferral is unnecessary

least_laxity_first.completion_behavior: Service-aware through laxity; not a pure completion rule.
least_laxity_first.fairness_behavior: No class debt except deadline effects.
known_failure_modes: admits urgent-looking work without preserving KV reserve
mostly redundant in Family C mean but still has a few unique wins
least_laxity_first.primary_scheduling_mechanism: Ranks by deadline laxity: deadline minus current time minus predicted remaining service.
strongest_workload_regimes: urgent deadline pressure when laxity is causal and KV reserve is not binding
weakest_workload_regimes: bulk KV pressure where reserve admission matters
Family C v2 where kv_constrained_online dominates mean ANWG

weighted_fair_share.completion_behavior: Can incur completion-related regret relative to ESTF.
weighted_fair_share.fairness_behavior: Strongest explicit fairness/class-deficit behavior among the six.
known_failure_modes: completion pressure when smaller/near-complete jobs should release first
insufficient alone for all Family A oracle headroom
weighted_fair_share.latency_slo_behavior: Protects priority/SLO/timeliness by class deficit; may sacrifice raw latency/completion efficiency.
weighted_fair_share.overlap_with_other_policies: Robust Family A parent but not a portfolio-expanding policy in prefill/KV mechanisms.
weighted_fair_share.primary_scheduling_mechanism: Ranks by class demand/served deficit times priority over estimated service.
strongest_workload_regimes: Family A favored-long/high-skew fairness and SLO protection
robust default in closed-loop Family A evidence
weakest_workload_regimes: cases where completion-efficient ESTF choices matter
favored-short or low-skew regimes where size ordering dominates
